cohort: The cohort consisted of 20 pregnant patients with asthma who received omalizumab for at least 6 months and at least one dose during their pregnancy, and their 23 infants.
finding: Omalizumab treatment during pregnancy appears safe for both mothers and their infants, showing improved maternal asthma control and no detected congenital anomalies in infants.
followup_time: Infants were followed for atopic diseases during their life.
